findings.finding: Original city-name-derived venue identities and opening hours were not verified. All display names explicitly mark fictional learning venues, with hours/address cleared. No real fares, prices, opening times, routes, office rules or service guarantees authored.
雲仙駅 was not verified as a real station. Retained supported Station/Station Staff for an explicitly fictional demo rail-route counter.
Corrected Community Staff to supported Park Staff for park-route discussion.

Other assigned category/job pairs retained from own input and supported category inventory. Medical actor remains nurse conducting intake, police consultation avoids deciding fraud or promising investigation, bank actor does not certify third-party payment legitimacy.
